releases.name: Android Release v1.7.0

- On chain fedimint support

releases.author: AnthonyRonning

- New activity items page

- Updates LDK to v0.0.118

* Bump to v0.4.27 by @TonyGiorgio in https://github.com/MutinyWallet/mutiny-web/pull/645
* Prod v0.4.27 by @TonyGiorgio in https://github.com/Mutin
